purpose.zh: 把八个概念行动包转译为可供后续专业团队复核的低扰动建设闸门和构件接口。
purpose.en: Translate eight conceptual action packages into low-impact delivery gates and component interfaces for later professional review.

required_before_design_development: pedestrian wind, shade and thermal baseline tied to actual accessible routes
utilities, drainage, fire and emergency access
authorized operator, maintenance budget and retirement responsibility

delivery_principles.zh: 普通路径先成立：导视、休息、转介和安全不能依赖模型或联网设备。
delivery_principles.en: Make the ordinary path work first: wayfinding, rest, referral and safety cannot depend on a model or connected device.

delivery_principles.zh: 先轻后重：先做可逆样机和限时试点，未经证据与专业复核不形成永久工程。
delivery_principles.en: Move from light to heavy: begin with reversible mock-ups and time-limited pilots; no permanent work precedes evidence and professional review.

delivery_principles.zh: 技术可退场：每个智能构件必须有断网、断电、停用和拆除后的公共服务基线。
delivery_principles.en: Technology must be able to leave: every smart component needs an offline, unpowered, disabled and removed public-service baseline.

delivery_principles.zh: 维护即设计：清洁、检修、备件、投诉、版权、数据删除和最终拆除责任必须在开放前明确。
delivery_principles.en: Maintenance is design: cleaning, inspection, spares, complaints, rights, deletion and final removal responsibilities must be clear before opening.

delivery_principles.zh: 先登记后观察：先固定几何版本、环境条件、实际路线、缺测处理和专业接受标准，不用一次体验推定微气候绩效。
delivery_principles.en: Register before observing: fix the geometry version, environmental conditions, actual route, missing-data treatment and professional acceptance criteria; one visit cannot establish microclimate performance.

purpose.zh: 把京张铁路的站、里程与交接语法转译为逐构件的空间交付单元，避免用一份泛化流程替整条线路笼统过关。
purpose.en: Translate the railway grammar of station, mile and handoff into a spatial delivery unit for each component, preventing one generic process from advancing the whole line by assertion.

spatial_layers.rule: Passage, wayfinding, rest or staffed help remains usable without a model, power or network.
Only an authorized, demountable test occupies this layer; it never narrows accessible clear width or makes participation compulsory.
An on-site marker exposes the component, current gate, operator, non-AI baseline, negative findings, stop condition and removal route.

station_handoffs.role_zh: 接收技术、安全与失效证据
station_handoffs.role_en: Receive technical, safety and failure evidence

station_handoffs.role_zh: 接收权利、维护、责任与成果转移证据
station_handoffs.role_en: Receive rights, maintenance, accountability and transfer evidence

station_handoffs.role_zh: 接收真实使用、非参与者影响、退出与投诉证据
station_handoffs.role_en: Receive real-use, non-participant impact, opt-out and complaint evidence

proof_mile_delivery_protocol.advance_rule: A gate advances one named component only. Evidence from another component, location or public problem cannot be substituted, and no gate pass replaces statutory design or approval.
proof_mile_delivery_protocol.public_marker: The public evidence rail must remain readable without an account, QR code or personal device and must identify a staffed or telephone route for question, complaint and opt-out.
proof_mile_delivery_protocol.derivation_boundary: The Proof-Mile protocol is derived from Proofline's own railway identity, public-interest objective, component gates and three differentiated station handoffs.

readiness_gates.entry: A provisional action package has a named public problem, affected users, non-AI baseline and stop condition.
required_outputs: rights-cleared official base and ownership interface
topographic, tree, pavement, accessibility and condition survey
preregistered pedestrian wind, heat and shade observation plan tied to geometry version and actual accessible routes
heritage, transport, drainage, utility, fire and operations constraint register
record of unresolved conflicts and no-build areas
readiness_gates.pass_condition: Every professional domain classifies the proposed test location as proceed, revise or do not proceed; unknowns remain visible.
readiness_gates.stop_condition: Ownership, heritage sensitivity, emergency access, critical utility conflict or an accountable operator cannot be resolved.

readiness_gates.name_zh: 授权场地 1:1 可逆样机
readiness_gates.entry: CR0 passes for a bounded, authorized location.
required_outputs: full-scale off-line or passive mock-up
wheelchair, low-vision, older-person and maintenance walkthrough
observation record naming geometry version, environmental condition, route coverage and unobserved cases
assembly, anchoring, edge, glare, drainage and removal review
photographic record and snag list
readiness_gates.pass_condition: The ordinary route remains continuous; components can be maintained and removed without damaging protected fabric.
readiness_gates.stop_condition: The mock-up creates a trip, pinch, glare, drainage, fire, heritage or maintenance hazard.

readiness_gates.entry: CR1 passes and a responsible test lead approves a written protocol.
required_outputs: bounded test area and exclusion logic
manual override, emergency stop and incident record
data minimization and deletion test where technology is used
positive, negative and aborted results
readiness_gates.pass_condition: Normal, degraded and emergency states are understandable to operators and affected users; failure returns to a safe non-AI state.
readiness_gates.stop_condition: Manual control, physical separation, privacy protection or incident response fails.

readiness_gates.name_zh: 获许可的限时公共试点
readiness_gates.entry: CR2 passes, required permits exist, the public notice is readable and a staffed fallback is operating.
required_outputs: start and end time, responsible operator and visible opt-out
baseline and evaluation method agreed before opening
complaint, accessibility and incident channels
daily close-down and removal check
readiness_gates.pass_condition: The pilot improves the stated public problem without worsening safety, access, privacy, maintenance or non-participant service.
readiness_gates.stop_condition: A serious incident, repeated accessibility failure, unresolved complaint, unauthorized collection or loss of responsible staffing occurs.

readiness_gates.entry: The CR3 end date is reached or a stop condition triggers early review.
required_outputs: public comparison with the pre-pilot baseline
positive, negative, distributional and maintenance findings
retain, modify or remove decision with accountable sign-off
data deletion, material recovery and site reinstatement record
readiness_gates.pass_condition: A reasoned decision is published and any retained work enters statutory design, approval, funding and procurement processes separately.
readiness_gates.stop_condition: No evidence supports retention, recurring cost or responsibility is unresolved, or public harm outweighs benefit.

components.name_zh: 普通导视与人工帮助点
components.name_en: Ordinary wayfinding and staffed help point
components.proof_mile_role: Establish the ordinary-service base and the public evidence rail before any digital interface is enabled.
components.purpose_zh: 在任何数字界面启用前提供可读方向、距离、开放状态、人工转介与退出入口。
components.purpose_en: Provide readable direction, distance, opening status, staffed referral and exit before any digital interface is enabled.
professional_prerequisites: pedestrian desire-line and decision-point survey
accessible information and visual-contrast review
ownership, heritage attachment and emergency-egress review
components.non_ai_baseline: Printed or mechanically updateable information plus a staffed or telephone fallback remains usable without power or network.
components.inspection: Daily legibility and obstruction check during a pilot; scheduled fixing, edge and surface inspection by the authorized operator.
components.failure_mode: Outdated information, glare, visual clutter, inaccessible height, blocked clear width or absent staff fallback.
components.stop_or_remove: Cover incorrect content immediately; remove or relocate a component that narrows the accessible path, attaches to uncleared heritage fabric or lacks a maintainer.

components.name_zh: 无障碍树荫休息与服务湾
components.name_en: Accessible shaded rest and service bay
components.proof_mile_role: Test the three-layer construction bay while preserving a continuous ordinary accessible route outside the test pocket.
components.purpose_zh: 把连续通行、树荫、不同坐姿、轮椅并坐空间和人工服务组合为不依赖智能设备的基础节点。
components.purpose_en: Combine continuous passage, shade, varied seating, wheelchair companion space and staffed service as a non-digital base node.
professional_prerequisites: continuous accessible-route survey
tree health, root zone and pavement review
preregistered pedestrian wind, shade and thermal observations tied to geometry version, environmental condition and the actual accessible route
fire, cleaning, waste and winter-maintenance access
components.non_ai_baseline: Shade, seating, clear width and assistance remain functional with no sensor, screen or model.
components.inspection: Pre-opening user walkthrough plus declared-condition checks for clear width, surface, shade state, pedestrian wind and heat, seating stability and drainage; record unobserved conditions instead of extrapolating.
components.failure_mode: Unsafe or materially uncomfortable wind or heat, inadequate shade, ponding, root damage, unstable seating, blocked movement or exclusionary armrest and height choices.
components.stop_or_remove: Close, reroute or reset the bay when safe clear width, surface stability, wind-heat condition, shade or maintenance access cannot be maintained.

components.proof_mile_role: Prove passive water behavior and reinstatement at component scale before any sensor-assisted extension.
components.purpose_zh: 用可观察的小尺度雨水花园、树池或生态边缘验证遮荫、径流管理和维护接口。
components.purpose_en: Use an observable small rain garden, tree pit or ecological edge to test shade, runoff management and maintenance interfaces.
professional_prerequisites: soil, groundwater, contamination and infiltration testing
catchment, overflow, winter and extreme-rain review
river, drainage, utility, tree and accessibility approval interfaces
components.non_ai_baseline: Passive inlet, overflow and visible maintenance access work without sensors; monitoring is supplementary only.
components.inspection: Inspect after representative rainfall for ponding, scour, blocked inlet, plant survival, edge safety and overflow behavior.
components.failure_mode: Persistent ponding, polluted inflow, unsafe drop, blocked overflow, utility conflict, mosquito risk or maintenance abandonment.
components.stop_or_remove: Bypass and make safe immediately when water quality, overflow, edge or utility risk appears; do not scale from a dry-weather mock-up.

components.proof_mile_role: Make the current gate, evidence boundary, operator, negative findings and removal route publicly legible on site.
components.purpose_zh: 展示试点目的、责任人、数据边界、正负结果、申诉和退出，不把广告或设备数量当作公共价值。
components.purpose_en: Show purpose, accountability, data boundary, positive and negative results, appeal and exit without treating advertising or device quantity as public value.
professional_prerequisites: content owner, accessibility and consumer-rights review
power, fire, weather, cyber and privacy review
luminance, noise, heritage-view and attachment review
components.non_ai_baseline: A passive board and human contact remain available; the screen can be dark, disconnected or physically removed without closing the service.
components.inspection: Content-date, luminance, enclosure, electrical protection, accessibility and complaint-channel check before each open period.
components.failure_mode: Stale or promotional content, inaccessible interaction, excessive luminance, unauthorized tracking, exposed cable or no responsible editor.
components.stop_or_remove: Switch off immediately on privacy, electrical, content-rights or accountability failure; retain passive information while review proceeds.

components.name_zh: 机器人沙盒边界与急停构件
components.name_en: Robot sandbox boundary and emergency-stop kit
components.proof_mile_role: Confine automated testing to the reversible test pocket and expose emergency stop ownership on the evidence rail.
components.purpose_zh: 只在获授权控制场地内建立低速、分时、物理分隔、现场监护和一键急停的测试边界。
components.purpose_en: Create a low-speed, time-slotted, physically separated, supervised and emergency-stoppable test boundary only in an authorized controlled site.
professional_prerequisites: road and site authority plus written test permit
conflict-point, stopping-distance and containment test
insurance, incident command, fire and first-aid interface
accessibility-user and operator walkthrough
components.non_ai_baseline: The public route remains outside the sandbox and fully usable; physical barriers and a human marshal do not depend on autonomy.
components.inspection: Pre-run brake, emergency-stop, barrier, communications and exclusion-zone check; incident log after every abnormal event.
components.failure_mode: Boundary breach, unexpected acceleration, loss of localization or communication, unsafe stop, public-route encroachment or absent marshal.
components.stop_or_remove: Stop on the first safety-critical failure; isolate power, record the event and prohibit public restart until independent professional review.

components.name_zh: 贡献谱系与铁路记忆展架
components.proof_mile_role: Carry railway memory and the component's full evidence lineage across the three differentiated station handoffs.
components.purpose_zh: 以可逆、可维护的独立展架并列呈现铁路记忆、贡献来源、失败试验和撤回入口。
components.purpose_en: Use a reversible, maintainable free-standing frame to present railway memory, contribution provenance, failed trials and withdrawal routes together.
professional_prerequisites: heritage significance and view-corridor assessment
copyright, attribution, privacy and withdrawal clearance
wind, overturning, fire, egress and material-weathering review
components.non_ai_baseline: Rights-cleared physical interpretation remains readable without an account, QR code, network or personal device.
components.inspection: Scheduled review of provenance, withdrawal status, legibility, fixings, corrosion and trip or egress conflicts.
components.failure_mode: Uncleared content, contested attribution, heritage imitation, visual obstruction, unstable frame or abandoned digital link.
components.stop_or_remove: Hide disputed content pending Human Review; remove any frame that damages heritage fabric, impairs egress or has no rights and maintenance owner.

professional_signoff_domains.responsibility: location, public-space continuity, statutory interface and design coherence
base survey, rights, access, work limits and reinstatement
significance, fabric, views, archaeology, attachment and interpretation
walking, cycling, transit, emergency access, universal design and representative user review
trees, soil, pedestrian microclimate, shade, infiltration, drainage, overflow, water quality, habitat and maintenance
stability, anchoring, buried services, power, weather protection, fire and emergency isolation
collection boundary, cybersecurity, consumer rights, copyright, appeal, deletion and Human Review
accountable operator, staff, inspection, cleaning, spares, budget, incident response, removal and material recovery

handoff_rule: Under One Component, One Proof-Mile, a named component may advance only when its own current-gate evidence is complete, every applicable professional domain records proceed or revise, affected users can inspect the non-AI baseline, and an accountable party can stop and remove it. A pass is component- and location-specific and is not permission to skip statutory design, approval, funding or procurement.
